dogecoin.text:
Elon Musk has reached a deal to acquire Twitter, and the price of Dogecoin is surging because of this.

Welcome the new Twitter CEO. https://t.co/ufEjf2okSx

Yesterday on Twitter, news broke - Elon Musk had reached a deal to acquire Twitter for $44 billion, and the price of Dogecoin surged as a result.

I talk about the events leading to the purchase of the social media giant on this article.
